# ChineseSnacks - Complete Content

## About ChineseSnacks

ChineseSnacks is a practical Chinese street food guide covering Beijing, Chengdu, Xi an, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Chongqing. Every snack comes with a specific street or stall, a price range in yuan, and the exact Chinese phrase to say.

We verify every recommendation: each snack street was visited in person, prices are updated seasonally, and listings are cross-checked with local residents. No sponsored placements. No affiliate links.

## Key Snacks

### Jianbing - Beijing
China s most famous breakfast crepe. Thin batter on a hot griddle, egg cracked on top, folded around crispy wonton crackers, scallions, and fermented bean paste. Price: 5-15 yuan. Best at Wangfujing Snack Street.

### Chuanchuan - Chengdu
Skewered ingredients cooked in spicy mala broth. Choose your skewers, hand them over, and watch them boil. Price: 0.5-3 yuan per skewer.

### Shengjianbao - Shanghai
Pan-fried pork buns with crispy golden bottom and juicy filling. Price: 8-15 yuan for 4.

### Xiaolongbao - Shanghai
Steamed soup dumplings with delicate skin and hot broth inside. Price: 15-30 yuan per steamer.

### Dandan Noodles - Chengdu
Sichuan noodles topped with minced pork, preserved vegetables, and chili oil. Price: 8-15 yuan.

### Yangrou Chuan - Xi an / Beijing
Lamb skewers seasoned with cumin and chili. Price: 2-5 yuan per skewer.

## Key Cities

### Beijing - jianbing, tanghulu, zhajiangmian, yangrou chuan
### Chengdu - chuanchuan, dandan noodles, mapo doufu, liangpi
### Xi an - yangrou paomo, roujiamo, liangpi
### Shanghai - xiaolongbao, shengjianbao, congyoubing
### Chongqing - xiaomian, malatang
### Guangzhou - cheong fun, dan ta, dim sum

## Ordering Phrases
- Zhe ge, yi ge - This one, one please
- Duo shao qian? - How much?
- Bu yao la - Not spicy
- Wei dao hen hao! - It tastes great!
